[[File:AntidoteKit.png|thumb|An antidote kit.]]
An '''antidote kit''' contained a variety of wide-spectrum antidote hypospray injectors that were designed to neutralize all known [[Poison/Legends|poisons]]. Any affected abilities were returned to normal and physical damage was halted. Damage already suffered needed to be healed by other means.
